meta.title: About SGS International | EPC & O&M Contractor
meta.description: SGS is an EPC and O&M contractor delivering solar, water, and civil infrastructure projects, with a track record of 5 water treatment plants in Qatar.

hero.text: We deliver solar, water, and civil infrastructure projects — from design and construction through to commissioning and O&M.

intro.title: Built on delivery
intro.text: We are an EPC and O&M contractor working across solar PV, water treatment, and civil infrastructure. Our track record is anchored by 5 water treatment plants delivered in Qatar, and we bring the same approach to every project.

market_focus.text: We engineered, built, commissioned, and operated 5 water treatment plants in Qatar. That experience underpins how we approach solar and civil projects today.
